questions.prompt: The database is opened read-only and the gate allows only SELECT. Why keep both?
options: They are the same check, so one is a backup copy
They are independent layers, so one still holds if the other fails
pi requires two checks for every tool
questions.explanation: The gate is code that can have a bug. The read-only file is a separate layer, so a write still fails if the gate misses it.

questions.prompt: Why does the tool list keep read, although the SQL analyst has its own tools?
options: The skills section appears only when read or bash is available
pi refuses to start without read
The base pack needs read to log
questions.explanation: pi shows skills in the prompt only if read or bash is on the tool list. Without read the analyst silently loses its skill.

questions.prompt: In the example table, plain pi passes 9 of 20 tasks and the pack passes 17 of 20. What is the lift?
questions.explanation: The pack passes 85% and plain pi passes 45%. The difference, 40 percentage points, is the lift.
